mapper.select: select count(*) from monitor_event e where e.event_type = 'alert' and e.event_id in #{id}
select min(e.start_hour) from monitor_event e where e.event_type = 'alert' and e.status = 'open' and e.metric_code = #{metricCode}
mapper.update: update monitor_event set handle_status = 'done', handle_note = #{note}, handled_by = #{userId}, handled_at = #{now}, handled_level = level, handle_reset = false, update_time = #{now} where site_code = #{scope.siteCode} and event_type = 'alert' and event_id in #{id}

update monitor_event set handle_status = 'pending', handle_note = null, handled_by = null, handled_at = null, handled_level = null, handle_reset = false, update_time = #{now} where site_code = #{scope.siteCode} and event_type = 'alert' and event_id = #{eventId}
